top10.title: Fake data shown as real
top10.detail: Game page "Performance & graphics" card is hardcoded (Up to date: FSR, XeSS, DLSS / Built into the game / Optimize Applied) for every installed game (game_page.rs:149-190, seen in smoke game-page.png); display mode picker does nothing (state.rs:1263); Exo AI "Auto Tune complete" with six static green rows is hardcoded (pc.rs ~1615-1700, seen in smoke pc.png). The user sees confident wrong information.

top10.title: Settings covers 6 of 13+ sections
top10.detail: No store sign-in or account management (Steam/Epic/GOG/EA, accounts.*, steam.signIn*), no Exo Account (create/sign in/recovery/devices/delete), no privacy/telemetry view, no Report a problem, no Apps/web preferences, no FPS/achievement/install-folder/download-hours settings (smoke settings-general.png shows 3 rows).

top10.title: No folders, no select mode, no gifts
top10.detail: Library "New folder" shows a "Folder management coming soon" toast (menus.rs:722, :1591); no FolderSheet/Card/Panel/Cropper, no multi-select bar, no gifts shelf, no drag reorder, no Ctrl+F/Ctrl+A or grid keyboard nav.

top10.title: Downloads are invisible
top10.detail: No Downloads sheet, no Exo Island, no queue/pause-all/resume-all/reorder (downloads.* never called), no progress outside the game page, no What's New / update sheet, no update progress.

top10.title: Events are dropped: no toasts or system notices
top10.detail: 42 of 77 host push events are ignored (discord.notify, anticheat.missing, stores.outage, gpu.driverInstall, keys.found, app.notify, versions.new, gifts.changed, game.optimizeHeld ...). Anti-cheat prompts, store outages and driver installs happen with nothing on screen.

top10.title: Store game page is broken and bare
top10.detail: Smoke store-game.png: offer rows labelled "1" and "25" (raw store ids), raw ISO timestamp in "Historical low", no hero art, no trailer, no screenshots, no system requirements, no wishlist toggle, no reviews list.

top10.title: Captures: Notes dead, no editors
top10.detail: Both Notes buttons are mis-wired (captures.rs ~290 reopens Captures; ~786 reloads it). No notes.* (11 methods), no Snip editor, no send-to, no reel. Exo Capture-not-installed state is the only thing the smoke run could exercise.

top10.title: Devices: controller, audio format, EQ are stubs
top10.detail: Controller detail is a connection/battery card (controller.* 10 methods never called: no calibration, no pad settings, no game profiles, no update). No audio format picker, Exo Voice, AutoEQ (eq.headphones never called). Mouse is a host-embedded panel that the headless snapshot cannot show.

top10.title: Discord is a chat client without most of Discord
top10.detail: Rooms/DMs/friends/voice render well, but no emoji/GIF/sticker pickers, no file upload, threads, polls, search, saved, inbox content, soundboard, call UI outside the room, server/channel/user settings pages, report, forward, nickname/timeout/ban.

top10.title: Apps and Music dead-end
top10.detail: Apps: no scan, restore point, undo, installer cache, leftovers confirm, packages. Music: room sits on "Starting Apple Music…" with no sign-in/change-service flow in the smoke run, no artist page, lyrics, sound panel, device picker, friend activity.
